description: Look up how well an AI agent could use a website when Botworthy last scanned it: whether it blocked agents, the score out of 100, advice, and for each of 5 everyday tasks the outcome and the exact steps (control role and accessible name) that worked. Accepts any URL or domain. If the site hasn't been scanned, says whether a scan is queued.

site.description: A URL or domain, e.g. https://www.example.com/shop or example.com

name: check_site
title: Check a website before visiting it
